The function $\delta$ is the chordal distance from $L(j\omega)$ to the critical point $-1$, so small values indicate proximity to instability. The smallest distance over all frequencies determines the margin in {eq:bncf}. All estimator branches use the capped distance

The identity $|1+L|^{2}-(1+|L|^{2})=2\,\mathrm{Re}\,L$ shows that $\delta(L)>\delta(0)=1/\sqrt{2}$ only where $\mathrm{Re}\,L>0$. Thus the cap limits contributions from these frequencies while preserving all smaller distances. It also bounds the reported indicator by $1/\sqrt{2}$.
